From 4492b9e7302b8c84dddec9713d8148cc6183f46b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Haohui Mai <wheat9@apache.org>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2015 16:47:44 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] HADOOP-12294. Remove the support of the deprecated dfs.umask.
 Contributed by Chang Li.


diff --git a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/fs/permission/FsPermission.java b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/fs/permission/FsPermission.java
index 0258293823e..d4adbb59d94 100644
--- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/fs/permission/FsPermission.java
+++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/fs/permission/FsPermission.java
@@ -258,22 +258,8 @@ public static FsPermission getUMask(Configuration conf) {
         String error = "Unable to parse configuration " + UMASK_LABEL
             + " with value " + confUmask + " as " + type + " umask.";
         LOG.warn(error);
-        
-        // If oldUmask is not set, then throw the exception
-        if (oldUmask == Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
-          throw new IllegalArgumentException(error);
-        }
-      }
-        
-      if(oldUmask != Integer.MIN_VALUE) { // Property was set with old key
-        if (umask != oldUmask) {
-          LOG.warn(DEPRECATED_UMASK_LABEL
-              + " configuration key is deprecated. " + "Convert to "
-              + UMASK_LABEL + ", using octal or symbolic umask "
-              + "specifications.");
-          // Old and new umask values do not match - Use old umask
-          umask = oldUmask;
-        }
+
+        throw new IllegalArgumentException(error);
       }
     }
     
--

### Modifications in Each File

1. **FsPermission.java**
   - The code related to handling the deprecated `dfs.umask` configuration has been removed. Specifically:
     - The checks for the old umask value and the associated warnings have been eliminated.
     - The logic that allowed fallback to the old umask if the new one did not match has been removed.
     - The method now directly throws an `IllegalArgumentException` if the configuration cannot be parsed, without any fallback mechanism.

2. **CHANGES.txt**
   - A new entry has been added to document the removal of support for the deprecated `dfs.umask` configuration. This entry notes the issue number (HADOOP-12294) and credits the contributor (Chang Li).

### Relationships Between Modifications
The changes in `FsPermission.java` directly implement the removal of support for the deprecated `dfs.umask` configuration, as indicated in the CHANGES.txt file. The documentation update serves to inform users and developers about this significant change in functionality, ensuring that the removal of the deprecated feature is clearly communicated in the project's change log.

// Remove the handling of the deprecated key
if (oldUmask != Integer.MIN_VALUE) { // Property was set with old key

}
```
